messages:
From: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@luminahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence rhythm & pen test language

Monica / Logan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our MSA/order form review I want to confirm two things so we can get internal sign-off this week:

1) SOC 2 evidence cadence — Lumina's InfoSec needs weekly access to a scoped artifact set for the first 90 days, then monthly snapshots thereafter. Can Redwood confirm what items you can commit to produce (reports, SAML configs, audit logs, sampling)? We typically list a concrete runbook in the security exhibit.

2) Pen test and forensic access — our security team requires a defined notice window, staging credentials, and a minimal list of logs for root cause analysis. We saw some of Redwood's standard language but want to confirm you can provide ephemeral staging access during the test and a mechanism to retrieve redacted logs within 48 hours.

We also received an MSA redline from procurement that modifies the audit rights clause — I attached a summary (sent separately via our procurement portal). If you can produce a short MAP (mutual action plan) listing deliverables, owners and dates that would help expedite procurement.

Appreciate a quick reply with proposed wording or a calendar to align.

—Ben
Security Engineering | Lumina Health

Attachments: procurement_redline_summary.pdf (referenced in portal)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-12-03T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence rhythm & pen test language

Ben — thanks for the clear ask. Draft MAP and a first-pass redline are attached (Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx, SecurityExhibit_redline_v1.docx). High-level answers below; details are in the files and we can jump on a 30-min call if you'd prefer.

SOC 2 evidence cadence (proposal)
- Initial 90-day onboarding: weekly artifact bundle (SOC 2 report summary, configuration snapshot, access control list export, sample API call logs for 7-day window).
- Ongoing: monthly bundle with rolling 30-day logs and updated config snapshot.
- Format: encrypted zip via secure transfer link; delivery SLA: next business day for routine monthly bundles, 48 hours for ad-hoc requests tied to incidents.

Pen test / staging access (proposal)
- Notice: 10 business days notice for scheduled external pentests; short-window internal tests can be accommodated with 48-hour notice if pre-authorized by security contacts.
- Ephemeral staging: we provide time-limited staging credentials scoped to test IP ranges; staging mirrors production sanitized data if requested (data subsets only).
- Logs: full application and inference telemetry retained at 90 days, with forensic export within 48 hours of request; redaction pipeline available for PII-sensitive fields.

We captured specific redline suggestions in SecurityExhibit_redline_v1.docx — highlights: limit inspection to scoped artifacts, require mutually agreed inspection windows, and define evidence delivery SLAs. Karthik, looping you for legal redline triage and whether we should accept Lumina's procurement edits to the audit rights clause or propose alternative acceptance language.

Next steps / MAP (draft)
- Week 1 (Dec 4–8): Redwood to share final redline + MAP owners (Monica) — deliverable: SecurityExhibit_redline_v2.docx
- Week 2 (Dec 11–15): Joint call to walk artifacts and staging plan (Logan + Lumina Sec Eng) — calendar invite pending
- Week 3 (Dec 18–22): Pilot evidence delivery (weekly bundle) and one staged pentest window (test plan to be shared by Lumina)

If the calendar above looks ok I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet and check in with procurement.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx, SecurityExhibit_redline_v1.docx

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-12-04T10:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence rhythm & pen test language

Quick legal/ops triage. Monica — I reviewed the draft redline and left inline notes; major points below so procurement has a concrete counter: 

1) Audit rights: we cannot accept open-ended onsite inspections or unlimited sampling. Propose: "Customer may request inspection of scoped artifacts up to X times per rolling 12 months; requests require 10 business days' notice and scope agreed in advance." (X = 2 for standard enterprise; Lumina can request 4 for higher tiers).

2) Pen test indemnity / coordination: request to add clause requiring mutual statement of acceptable test categories (external network, app layer) and agreed blast radius. We must insist on an approved test plan and contact roster.

3) Evidence delivery SLA: we can provide artifact bundles next-business-day for routine monthly pulls, and 48-hour SLA for incident-related exports. We should codify exception process for complex exports.

4) Staging creds: confirm ephemeral creds TTL (default 72 hours) and IP allowlist. We should document the revoke and audit process in the exhibit.

Karthik — can you please convert the inline edits into a tracked-change redline (SecurityExhibit_redline_v2.docx) and add a short comment that explains the unacceptable procurement ask re: unlimited inspection? I’ll draft the calendar invite for the Week 2 walkthrough with Lumina Sec Eng.

—Logan
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Security exhibit — SOC 2 evidence rhythm & pen test language

Ben / Monica / Logan — attaching SecurityExhibit_redline_v2.docx (tracked changes) in the Drive link below and summarizing the legal position so procurement has a one-paragraph explanation to move the MSA forward.

Legal summary (for procurement):
- Audit rights: Redwood accepts a bounded inspection regime. Suggested language: "Customer audit rights limited to the artifacts listed in Appendix A, with a limit of two inspection events per rolling 12 months unless otherwise agreed in writing; inspection events require 10 business days' notice and must be conducted during mutually agreed windows."
- Evidence: Redwood will deliver evidence bundles per the cadence outlined in Appendix B; incident-related requests will be prioritized and delivered within 48 hours where feasible. Complex exports requiring engineering time will be scoped and quoted.
- Pen test coordination: All penetration testing requires an approved test plan and pre-authorized contact list; Redwood will provide ephemeral staging credentials and targeted logs for forensics subject to the agreed scope.
- Confidentiality & data handling: Redwood will redact PII where applicable and provide a signed NDA if the test requires access to sensitive artifacts.

Ben — if Lumina can accept the bounded inspection frequency and the 10-business-day notice, we can incorporate this into the order form language today and send the clean MSA for counter-signature. If Lumina needs more frequent inspections, let us know and we can propose a higher tier of reserved capacity with expanded inspection rights.

Drive link (redline + MAP): https://redwood.app/drive/Maps/LUM-2028-0421
HubSpot: HS-5782 (updated)

-Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
